organization.notes: Official About names private UK and Swiss businesses. Diagram software history since 2005, not asserted company founding. Explicitly not VC-funded; other financing history unresolved, so funding unknown rather than bootstrapped.

moats.claim: Broad file compatibility, shape libraries and long-lived diagram formats create ecosystem value; open format/code constrains exclusive lock-in.

productReasons.claim: Extensive technical shape libraries support architecture, UML and process diagrams.
Imports/exports across diagram formats help continue existing diagram work.
Mermaid, CSV and SQL inputs can generate diagrams from structured sources.

sponsorship.notes: Official sustainability/about source identifies commercial publishers, no corporate donor list. Paid Atlassian customers are not sponsors.

resources.notes: No documented minima in checked page; example -m1g container flag is an example limit, not a minimum.

selfHosting.notes: Editor can run as desktop or self-operated web container. Default container exports in browser and uses local/chosen storage; no required database, Redis, queue or SMTP. Paid Atlassian integrations separate.

options.notes: Single documented container command after installing Docker; not true one-click.

oneClickInstall.notes: Checked official deployment documentation; manual Docker Compose is not a one-click offer.
